findings.issue: The rationale says both accounts narrate going home. The actual Mark 2:12 unit says the man went out before everyone; going home is explicit in Luke 5:25. Mark 2:11 commanded going home, but that should not silently become a verbatim narrative detail of 2:12.
findings.fix: Both narrate the man immediately rising, taking his bed and departing, followed by amazement and glorification of God. Luke explicitly says he went home; Mark says he went out before everyone. Mark says the witnesses had never seen anything like it; Luke says they saw extraordinary things and explicitly describes fear.
